formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + という + わけだ
meaning_reference_en: no wonder; that's why; it follows that
notes_reference_en: States a conclusion that follows naturally from known facts, often with a feeling of 'now I understand'. Often preceded by だから, それで or どうりで.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + という + わけではない
meaning_reference_en: it doesn't mean that; it's not that; not necessarily
notes_reference_en: A partial or soft denial of what the listener might assume. Often with いつも, 全部 or 必ずしも. Not the same as 〜わけがない, which flatly rules something out.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + わけがない
meaning_reference_en: there's no way that; cannot possibly
notes_reference_en: The speaker's strong conviction that something is impossible. Casual: 〜わけない. Close to 〜はずがない, but sounds more emotional and less based on reasoning.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + わけにはいかない
meaning_reference_en: can't afford to; can't very well; must not (for social or moral reasons)
notes_reference_en: The action is physically possible but ruled out by duty, circumstances or common sense. 〜ないわけにはいかない means 'have to; can't avoid doing'.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものだ
meaning_reference_en: it's natural that; one should; used to (nostalgia); how ...! (deep feeling)
notes_reference_en: Main uses: general truth or natural tendency, a social norm (should), a nostalgic past habit with 〜たものだ, and deep feeling (時間がたつのは早いものだ). Casual: 〜もんだ.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + ものではない
meaning_reference_en: one shouldn't; it's not right to
notes_reference_en: Advice based on common sense or social norms, often from an older person. Casual: 〜もんじゃない. Sounds more like general wisdom than 〜べきではない.

formation_reference_en: Sentence + もの / もん
meaning_reference_en: because (casual excuse or self-justification)
notes_reference_en: Sounds pouty or self-justifying; often begins with だって. もん is more colloquial. Used by children and among close friends; avoid at work.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + な + ものだから / もので
meaning_reference_en: because; since (explaining or excusing a situation)
notes_reference_en: Explains or excuses something that wasn't fully under the speaker's control. The main clause can't be a command or request. もので is common in polite apologies.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことだ
meaning_reference_en: should; the best thing is to (advice)
notes_reference_en: Personal advice from someone in a position to give it (teacher, parent, senior). Not used toward superiors. Compare 〜ものだ, which appeals to general norms.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + ことはない
meaning_reference_en: there's no need to; don't have to
notes_reference_en: Reassures or advises that something is unnecessary. Don't confuse with 〜たことはない ('have never done').

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことにしている
meaning_reference_en: make it a rule to; make a point of
notes_reference_en: A personal rule the speaker (or subject) decided on and keeps. Compare 〜ことになっている, a rule or plan set by others.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことになっている
meaning_reference_en: it has been arranged that; it's the rule that; be supposed to
notes_reference_en: Rules, customs or plans decided by others (a company, school, society), not a personal choice. Compare 〜ことにしている.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + こと
meaning_reference_en: must; do (written rule or instruction)
notes_reference_en: Ends a sentence with こと to state a rule. Found in notices, regulations and teacher-to-student instructions. Impersonal; not used toward superiors.

romaji: you ni iu / you ni tanomu
formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ように言う / ように頼む
meaning_reference_en: tell someone to do; ask someone to do (reported command or request)
notes_reference_en: Reports an instruction or request indirectly. Works with other verbs too: 伝える, 注意する, お願いする. Direct-quote version: 「〜てください」と言う.

formation_reference_en: Verb-volitional + とする
meaning_reference_en: try to; attempt to; be about to
notes_reference_en: Often an attempt that fails or is interrupted. 〜ようとしない = 'won't even try' (unwillingness). Compare 〜てみる, which means actually doing something to see how it goes.

romaji: sou ni nai / sou mo nai
formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + そうにない / そうもない
meaning_reference_en: unlikely to; doesn't look like it will
notes_reference_en: Negative of the appearance 〜そうだ with verbs, based on what the speaker observes. More emphatic: 〜そうにもない. With adjectives use 〜なさそうだ instead.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + 一方だ
meaning_reference_en: keep on -ing; more and more (change in one direction)
notes_reference_en: Steady change in one direction, usually (not always) for the worse. Used with verbs of change such as 増える, 減る, 上がる, 悪くなる.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + である + 一方で
meaning_reference_en: while; on the other hand; at the same time
notes_reference_en: Presents two sides of one thing, or two parallel activities. Compare 〜に対して, which contrasts two different subjects.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に対して / Noun + に対する + Noun / Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + のに対して
meaning_reference_en: toward; against; in contrast to
notes_reference_en: Marks the target of an action, attitude or feeling, or contrasts two things. Compare 〜について, which marks the topic being discussed rather than a target.

formation_reference_en: Noun + について / Noun + についての + Noun
meaning_reference_en: about; concerning; regarding
notes_reference_en: Marks the topic of speaking, thinking or research. More formal: 〜に関して. Compare 〜に対して (the target of an attitude or action).

formation_reference_en: Noun + によって / Noun + による + Noun
meaning_reference_en: by (agent); by means of; due to; depending on
notes_reference_en: Uses: agent of a passive (formal, for creating or discovering), cause, means, and 'varies by'. 〜によっては = 'in some cases, depending on'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + によると / Noun + によれば
meaning_reference_en: according to
notes_reference_en: Names the source of information. The sentence usually ends in a hearsay expression such as 〜そうだ, 〜らしい or 〜ということだ.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + ばかりでなく
meaning_reference_en: not only ... but also
notes_reference_en: Same meaning as 〜だけでなく but a little more formal. The second part usually contains も or まで.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + だけでなく
meaning_reference_en: not only ... but also
notes_reference_en: Common in both speech and writing. Casual: 〜だけじゃなくて. Slightly less formal than 〜ばかりでなく.

formation_reference_en: Noun + も + Verb-ba + Noun + も / Noun + も + i-Adj stem + ければ + Noun + も
meaning_reference_en: both ... and ...; not only ... but also
notes_reference_en: Lists two facts of the same kind for emphasis; contrasting pairs (いいときも悪いときも) are very common. Compare 〜し, which lists reasons.

formation_reference_en: Noun + らしい
meaning_reference_en: typical of; befitting; truly like
notes_reference_en: Having the qualities you expect of the noun. Negative: 〜らしくない ('not like'). Differs from the hearsay 〜らしい (N4) and from 〜っぽい (looks like X but isn't).

formation_reference_en: Noun / Verb-stem / i-Adj stem + っぽい
meaning_reference_en: -ish; -like; tends to (casual)
notes_reference_en: Noun + っぽい: seems like X though it isn't (大人っぽい). Verb-stem + っぽい: tends to (怒りっぽい). Compare 〜らしい, which means truly typical of X.

formation_reference_en: Noun + 的な + Noun / Noun + 的に
meaning_reference_en: -ic; -al; in terms of
notes_reference_en: Turns a (usually kanji) noun into a na-adjective: 的な before nouns, 的に before verbs and adjectives. Many are best learned as words: 具体的, 基本的, 積極的.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / Noun + の + ような / ように
meaning_reference_en: like; as; such as
notes_reference_en: ような comes before nouns, ように before verbs and adjectives. AのようなB can also mean 'B such as A'. Casual: 〜みたいな / 〜みたいに.

formation_reference_en: まるで + Verb-plain / Noun + の + ようだ
meaning_reference_en: just like; as if
notes_reference_en: まるで signals a figurative comparison: it only seems so. Casual: まるで〜みたいだ. Compare N2 〜かのようだ.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に違いない
meaning_reference_en: must be; surely; no doubt
notes_reference_en: Strong conviction based on evidence or intuition; a slightly written tone. Compare 〜に決まっている, which is more subjective and conversational.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に決まっている
meaning_reference_en: certainly; is bound to; of course
notes_reference_en: A very confident, subjective judgment, common in conversation (〜に決まってる). More assertive than 〜に違いない and not suited to formal writing.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + 気がする / Verb-plain / Noun + の + ような + 気がする
meaning_reference_en: have a feeling that; feel like
notes_reference_en: A vague, intuitive impression rather than a firm judgment; ような気がする is even softer. Different from N4 〜がする (a smell, sound or taste).

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai stem + ずに
meaning_reference_en: without doing
notes_reference_en: More formal, written-style equivalent of 〜ないで. Irregular: する → せずに (not しずに), 来る → 来ずに (こずに).

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + まま
meaning_reference_en: as it is; unchanged; while still (in a state)
notes_reference_en: An expected change hasn't happened and the state continues. Often suggests something unusual or undesirable (leaving the lights on, shoes on indoors).

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + うちに
meaning_reference_en: while (before it changes); before it's too late; in the course of
notes_reference_en: Do something while a condition lasts, before it changes; or a change that happens unnoticed during an activity. Compare 〜間に, which marks a fixed period without that urgency.

pattern: 〜ところに / 〜ところへ / 〜ところを
romaji: tokoro ni / tokoro e / tokoro o
formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / Verb-ta + ところに / ところへ / ところを
meaning_reference_en: just when; at the moment (someone arrives or something interrupts)
notes_reference_en: ところに/へ: something happens or someone arrives at that moment, often interrupting. ところを: the scene is the object of a verb like 見る, 見つかる, 助ける. Set phrase: お忙しいところを.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ba + Verb-dict + ほど / i-Adj stem + ければ + i-Adj + ほど / na-Adj + なら + na-Adj + な + ほど
meaning_reference_en: the more ... the more
notes_reference_en: The same word is repeated, first in the ば/なら form, then in plain form. The first part can be dropped: 考えるほど分からなくなる.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + ほど
meaning_reference_en: to the extent that; so ... that
notes_reference_en: Shows degree with an example or comparison. Often interchangeable with 〜くらい, but ほど sounds more formal and suits high degrees; it can't mark something as minimal.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + くらい
meaning_reference_en: to the extent that; so ... that; at least (something minimal)
notes_reference_en: Like 〜ほど, shows degree. くらい can also mark something as small or easy ('at least; such a simple thing as'), a use ほど doesn't have.

formation_reference_en: Noun + さえ / Noun + でさえ / Noun + にさえ
meaning_reference_en: even
notes_reference_en: Gives an extreme example, implying 'so naturally the others too'. More formal than 〜も or 〜でも in this sense. As a subject: 〜でさえ. Compare N1 〜すら.

formation_reference_en: Noun + さえ + Verb-ba / Verb-stem + さえ + すれば / Verb-te + さえ + いれば
meaning_reference_en: if only; as long as; provided that
notes_reference_en: Stresses that this one condition is enough by itself, or is the only thing missing.

formation_reference_en: Noun + こそ
meaning_reference_en: precisely; it is ... that; (strong emphasis)
notes_reference_en: Singles out one thing as the very one that matters. こちらこそ is a set reply: 'the thanks/pleasure is mine'. Related N2 forms: 〜からこそ, 〜てこそ.

formation_reference_en: Noun + として / Noun + としての + Noun
meaning_reference_en: as; in the role or capacity of
notes_reference_en: States a role, status or category. Compare 〜にとって, which states from whose point of view a judgment is made.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にとって / Noun + にとっての + Noun
meaning_reference_en: for; to (from the standpoint of)
notes_reference_en: Followed by an evaluation (大切だ, 難しい, 便利だ). Not for actions or attitudes toward someone; use 〜に対して for those.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / Noun + にしては
meaning_reference_en: for (considering it's); unexpectedly for
notes_reference_en: The result is different from what you'd expect of X. Doesn't follow adjectives; compare 〜わりに, which can and focuses on degree (price, age, effort).

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / Noun + にしても
meaning_reference_en: even if; even considering; granted that
notes_reference_en: Accepts a point, then says it doesn't change the speaker's view. Often accepts a fact; compare 〜としても, which is more purely hypothetical.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に関して / Noun + に関する + Noun
meaning_reference_en: regarding; concerning; related to
notes_reference_en: More formal than 〜について; common in business, news and writing. Before a noun, use に関する (or に関しての).

formation_reference_en: Noun + に比べて / Verb-dict + のに比べて
meaning_reference_en: compared to; in comparison with
notes_reference_en: Also 〜と比べて, 〜に比べると and 〜に比べれば. Sets two things side by side more explicitly than 〜より.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に代わって / Noun + に代わり
meaning_reference_en: instead of; on behalf of; replacing
notes_reference_en: Someone acts for another person, or something new replaces something old. Written form: 〜に代わり. Compare 〜代わりに (instead of doing; in exchange for).

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + 代わりに
meaning_reference_en: instead of; in exchange for; to make up for
notes_reference_en: Three uses: substitution (instead of), exchange (in return for), and compensation (a downside balanced by an upside).

formation_reference_en: Noun + に従って / Verb-dict + に従って
meaning_reference_en: in accordance with; following; as ... (so ...)
notes_reference_en: With nouns such as rules or instructions: 'following, obeying'. With Verb-dict: proportional change like 〜につれて, in a more formal tone.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Noun + につれて
meaning_reference_en: as (one thing changes, another changes too)
notes_reference_en: Both halves describe gradual change. The main clause can't be a request or the speaker's intention. Close to 〜に従って and 〜とともに.

formation_reference_en: Noun + とともに / Verb-dict + とともに
meaning_reference_en: together with; along with; as; at the same time as
notes_reference_en: Formal version of 〜と一緒に. Also marks events happening at the same moment, or proportional change like 〜につれて.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Noun + の + たびに
meaning_reference_en: every time; whenever
notes_reference_en: Each time A happens, B happens too. More emphatic than 〜と or 〜ときはいつも.

formation_reference_en: Noun + ごとに / Verb-dict + ごとに
meaning_reference_en: every; each; at intervals of
notes_reference_en: Regular repetition, or each unit in turn. With Verb-dict it's close to 〜たびに. Careful: 一日ごとに = every day, but 一日おきに (N4) = every other day.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + いる / Noun + の + 最中に
meaning_reference_en: right in the middle of; while (busy with)
notes_reference_en: Stresses the height of an activity, usually when something unexpected interrupts it. Stronger than 〜中に or 〜ている間に. Also 〜最中だ.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + ついでに
meaning_reference_en: while (at it); on the occasion of; since one is doing it anyway
notes_reference_en: The main action happens anyway; the second is added because it's convenient. Compare N1 〜がてら.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + おかげで
meaning_reference_en: thanks to; because of (good result)
notes_reference_en: Cause of a good result, with a feeling of gratitude. Sometimes used sarcastically for a bad result (君のおかげで遅刻したよ). Compare 〜せいで (blame).

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + せいで
meaning_reference_en: because of; due to (bad result, blame)
notes_reference_en: Cause of a bad result, placing blame. 〜のせいにする = 'blame something on'. The opposite feeling of 〜おかげで.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + とたん / とたんに
meaning_reference_en: the moment; just as (something unexpected happens)
notes_reference_en: The second event is sudden and outside the speaker's control. Not used for the speaker's own planned actions, requests or intentions.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + ら ... Verb-ta
meaning_reference_en: when I did A, (I found that) B; upon doing, I discovered
notes_reference_en: After an action, the speaker notices or discovers something. The second clause is past and outside the speaker's control. 〜と〜た is a more written equivalent.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + って / i-Adj-ku + たって / na-Adj / Noun + だって
meaning_reference_en: even if; no matter (casual)
notes_reference_en: Colloquial form of 〜ても / 〜でも, often with いくら or question words. だって also means 'because' at the start of a sentence, and 'even' after nouns.

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai / i-Adj-ku + ない / na-Adj + でない + ことはない
meaning_reference_en: it's not that ... not; can if necessary; not impossible
notes_reference_en: A double negative giving a hesitant 'yes'. Also 〜ないこともない. Don't confuse with Verb-dict + ことはない ('there's no need to').

pattern: 〜てしょうがない / 〜てしかたがない
romaji: te shou ga nai / te shikata ga nai
formation_reference_en: Verb-te / i-Adj-ku + て / na-Adj + で + しょうがない / しかたがない
meaning_reference_en: extremely; can't help (feeling); unbearably
notes_reference_en: For feelings and sensations the speaker can't control. しょうがない is more casual. Unlike 〜てたまらない, it also works with spontaneous verbs like 気になる or 涙が出る.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te / i-Adj-ku + て / na-Adj + で + たまらない
meaning_reference_en: unbearably; dying to; extremely (feeling)
notes_reference_en: Strong, direct feelings or bodily sensations; very common with desire (〜たくてたまらない). Not used for objective facts. Compare 〜てしかたがない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + はじめて
meaning_reference_en: only after; not until
notes_reference_en: Something is realized or becomes possible only after an experience; often followed by 分かる, 気づく or 知る. Also written 〜て初めて.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + ばかりいる
meaning_reference_en: do nothing but; keep on doing (critical)
notes_reference_en: A repeated or constant action, usually with criticism or dissatisfaction. Compare N4 Noun + ばかり (甘い物ばかり食べる).

formation_reference_en: Verb-ba + いい / i-Adj stem + ければ + いい
meaning_reference_en: should; all you need to do is; I hope (with のに/けど: I wish)
notes_reference_en: Asks for or gives advice (〜ばいいですか = 'what should I do?'). 〜ばいいのに = 'I wish'. 〜たらいい is a near-synonym; 〜ほうがいい sounds more insistent.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + 場合（は）
meaning_reference_en: in the case of; if; in the event that
notes_reference_en: Typical of instructions, rules and announcements about possible situations. Unlike 〜たら, it is not used to narrate a one-off past event.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + とすれば / としたら
meaning_reference_en: if; supposing that; assuming
notes_reference_en: Sets up a hypothesis and considers what follows. Often with もし or 仮に. としたら is more conversational; とすれば sounds more like logical reasoning.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + としても
meaning_reference_en: even if; even supposing
notes_reference_en: Hypothetical concession: even assuming A, B still holds. More hypothetical than 〜ても; compare 〜にしても, which often accepts a fact.

formation_reference_en: Sentence + とか
meaning_reference_en: I heard something like; apparently
notes_reference_en: Vague hearsay; softer and less certain than 〜そうだ. Often 〜とかいう話だ, 〜とか聞いた, or 〜とかで (giving a reported reason). Different from listing 〜とか〜とか.

formation_reference_en: Sentence + って / Noun + って
meaning_reference_en: (casual quotation) says that; I heard; as for; what is
notes_reference_en: Casual stand-in for と (quoting), そうだ (hearsay, often 〜んだって) and は (topic, especially 'what is X?'). Common in speech; avoided in formal writing.

formation_reference_en: Sentence + ということだ
meaning_reference_en: I heard that; it means that; in other words
notes_reference_en: Two uses: reporting information (more formal than 〜そうだ) and drawing a conclusion ('so that means ...'). The conclusion use often ends in ということですね.

formation_reference_en: Noun / Sentence + というのは
meaning_reference_en: what is meant by ... is; ... means; the reason is
notes_reference_en: Introduces a word to define or a situation to comment on. Casual: 〜って. At the start of a sentence, というのは introduces a reason ending in 〜からだ. Written: 〜とは.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というより
meaning_reference_en: rather than; not so much A as B
notes_reference_en: Corrects or refines a description: the second one fits better. Often followed by むしろ.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + わりに
meaning_reference_en: considering; for (unexpectedly)
notes_reference_en: The result doesn't match the degree you'd expect from A (price, age, effort). Can follow adjectives, unlike 〜にしては.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + くせに
meaning_reference_en: even though; despite (critical, reproachful)
notes_reference_en: Like 〜のに, but with contempt or reproach toward the subject. Both clauses share the same subject; rarely used about oneself. Casual.

formation_reference_en: Noun + から + Noun + にかけて
meaning_reference_en: from ... through; over (a period or area)
notes_reference_en: A rough span of time or space whose edges aren't exact; common in weather reports. Compare 〜から〜まで, which marks clear start and end points.

formation_reference_en: Noun + ぶり / Verb-stem + ぶり
meaning_reference_en: for the first time in (a period); manner, way of doing
notes_reference_en: Time span + ぶり: the first time in that long (〜ぶりに / 〜ぶりの). Noun or Verb-stem + ぶり: the way someone does something (仕事ぶり, 話しぶり).

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta / Noun + だ / Noun + だった + っけ
meaning_reference_en: was it?; did I?; (trying to recall)
notes_reference_en: Checks something you've forgotten, or recalls the past fondly (〜たっけ). Polite forms: 〜でしたっけ, 〜ましたっけ.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + ますように / Verb-stem + ませんように
meaning_reference_en: I hope; may (wish, prayer)
notes_reference_en: Used for wishes and prayers, e.g. at a shrine or on tanabata strips, and at the end of letters wishing someone well.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + ふりをする
meaning_reference_en: pretend to; act as if
notes_reference_en: Deliberately giving a false impression. Verb-ta is common: 寝たふり, 死んだふり.

formation_reference_en: Noun + 向き / Noun + 向け
meaning_reference_en: suitable for / aimed at; intended for
notes_reference_en: 向き: happens to suit X well. 向け: made on purpose for X. 向き also means 'facing' (南向きの部屋).

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem / Noun + がち
meaning_reference_en: tend to; be prone to; often
notes_reference_en: A frequent tendency toward something undesirable. Compare 〜やすい (easily happens, can be neutral) and 〜気味 (a slight sign of a condition now).

formation_reference_en: Noun / Verb-stem + 気味
meaning_reference_en: a touch of; slightly; somewhat (in that condition)
notes_reference_en: A slight sign of a (usually negative) condition at present. Compare 〜がち, which means something happens often.

formation_reference_en: Noun + だらけ
meaning_reference_en: full of; covered with; riddled with
notes_reference_en: An unpleasantly large amount of something covering or filling a place; usually negative. Compare N1 〜まみれ (covered in something sticky or dirty).

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + 切る / Verb-stem + 切れない
meaning_reference_en: do completely; finish / can't finish; too many to
notes_reference_en: Doing something through to the very end. Also describes a total state: 疲れ切る ('be utterly exhausted'). Often written in kana: 〜きる / 〜きれない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + かける / Verb-stem + かけの + Noun
meaning_reference_en: half-done; start to; be about to
notes_reference_en: An action has started but isn't finished, or something is on the verge of happening (死にかける). Verb-stem + かけの + noun describes the half-finished thing.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + 合う
meaning_reference_en: do to each other; do together
notes_reference_en: Reciprocal or shared action. Many compounds are set words: 話し合う, 知り合う, 付き合う, 助け合う.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + 直す
meaning_reference_en: redo; do over again (to fix or improve)
notes_reference_en: Doing something again in order to correct or improve it. Plain repetition (もう一度〜する) doesn't carry that sense of fixing.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + づらい
meaning_reference_en: hard to; difficult or uncomfortable to
notes_reference_en: Stresses the doer's physical or psychological discomfort. 〜にくい (N4) is more objective, describing a thing's nature. Formal N2: 〜がたい.

romaji: beki da / beki de wa nai
formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + べきだ / Verb-dict + べきではない
meaning_reference_en: should; ought to / should not
notes_reference_en: A strong opinion about what is right or one's duty; too blunt to use toward superiors. する → すべき or するべき. Compare 〜ほうがいい (advice) and 〜ものだ (social norm).

formation_reference_en: Noun + ほど + i-Adj / na-Adj + な + Noun + はない
meaning_reference_en: nothing is as ... as; there's no ... like
notes_reference_en: Says X is the most ... of all, usually from personal experience or feeling. Also 〜くらい〜はない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + しかない
meaning_reference_en: have no choice but to; can only
notes_reference_en: No other option exists, so the speaker accepts this one. Differs from Noun + しか〜ない ('only'). Formal N2 equivalent: 〜ほかない.

formation_reference_en: Noun + まで / Noun + にまで
meaning_reference_en: even (an extreme case)
notes_reference_en: Adds an extreme item on top of others, often with surprise or dismay. Compare 〜さえ, which picks out one extreme example on its own.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + ところだった
meaning_reference_en: almost; nearly (but didn't)
notes_reference_en: Something (usually bad) came very close to happening but didn't. Often with もう少しで, 危うく or a 〜たら clause. Compare 〜そうになった.

formation_reference_en: Sentence + からといって
meaning_reference_en: just because (... doesn't mean); simply because
notes_reference_en: Denies that a reason automatically leads to a conclusion. Usually followed by a negative such as 〜わけではない or 〜とは限らない. Casual: 〜からって.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + とおりに / Noun + どおりに
meaning_reference_en: as; in the way that; exactly as
notes_reference_en: Doing something exactly like a model, instruction or prediction. Directly after a noun it becomes どおり (予定どおり, 思いどおり). に is often dropped. そのとおりだ = 'exactly'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + なんか / Noun + なんて / Sentence + なんて
meaning_reference_en: things like; the likes of (dismissive or humble); how ...! (surprise)
notes_reference_en: Casual version of など with a dismissive, humble or surprised tone. なんか also softens suggestions (お茶なんかどう？). Sentence + なんて shows surprise or disbelief.
